templates.name: Silver Locket
templates.description: An engraved silver locket containing two faded miniature portraits of family lost to the early bombardment.

templates.name: Faded Family Photograph
templates.description: A creased, salt-stained photograph showing smiling faces in front of a pre-war coastal cabin.

templates.name: Bone-Handled Hunting Knife
templates.description: A sturdy steel hunting knife with a carved antler grip, handed down across three generations of scouts.

templates.name: Cloth-Bound Journal
templates.description: Daily reflections and charcoal sketches recording the first ninety days following the atomic exchange.

templates.name: Knitted Wool Scarf
templates.description: A thick ochre scarf knitted by a mother in the last winter before the shelters sealed.

templates.name: Civilian Defense Merit Cross
templates.description: A tarnished brass medal awarded for emergency evacuation services in the city center.

templates.name: Brass Trench Lighter
templates.description: A reliable flint-wheel brass lighter made from spent shell casings, still striking a bright spark.

templates.name: Carved Pine Sparrow
templates.description: A small wooden songbird whittled by a sibling while trapped in a quarantine cellar.
